title: Melting Relaxation Induction (F4A  (Induction))
description: In this session, I want you to try to experience yourself, feel yourself, melting into the surface below you. To really tune into your body, and all the sensations present inside you. Noticing the weight of your ever heavier limbs, the temperature of the air as it glides across your skin, the gentle and subtle pulsing beat of your heart. All of it. And all of you. Feeling it, as my words flow relaxation up through you. Turning you to putty in my hands... Instructions I want you to find somewhere soft and comfy to lay back and escape from the bustling noisy interruptions of modern life. Pick a quiet peaceful spot, ok. You already know the perfect one, I'm sure. And then, when you're ready to melt into deep wonderful trance for me, just simply go ahead and press play. Whether this is your first time with me, or with trance, all I ask is that you trust me to take care of you, and accept that you want to relax. Let whatever you feel, or however you react, come naturally and easily.
author: Mistress Shibby
